comments.author: PerfectSituation1668
comments.body:
You mean generative AI? Because all games have rule based internal intelligence. I don't know of a game that uses LLMs. I've seen some funny interactive story experiences with LLMs in them or the Darth Vader in Fortnite, but nothing with actual LLMs that enhanched gameplay.

And for Diffusion models, that's probably used in a lot of games. Photoshop has AI support, so people probably use it when building stuff.

If someone made stuff without AI, they choose to do that. So probably every new big game you see has some AI in them.
